execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."category" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."inventory" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "rackId" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."order" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."orderItem" (
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "orderId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prediction" (
  "confidence" numeric,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "predictedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "barcode" text,
  "categoryId" int4,
  "costPrice" numeric,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric NOT NULL,
  "reorderLevel" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "safetyStock" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."rack" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stockMovement" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "performedBy" int4,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "rackId" int4,
  "referenceNumber" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "warehouseId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplier" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'staff' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "username" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warehouse" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "location" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
